---
title: "Public Safety Incident Data"
subtitle: "Overview"
---

This section analyzes incident-level data logged by El Cerrito's public
safety departments -- what gets called in, where it happens, and how
quickly it's handled. Unlike the [Public Safety](../public-safety/index.qmd)
section, which covers department organization, staffing, and budget, this
section works directly from the underlying incident records themselves.

## Police

A full analysis of every police incident logged from January 2019 through
June 2025 -- what officers actually spend their time on, where activity
concentrates geographically, how it has changed over time, and how
quickly the department responds. Includes a detailed technical appendix
documenting how the underlying dataset was built, cleaned, and verified,
including several real data-quality issues that were found and corrected
along the way.

[Read the full analysis &rarr;](police.qmd)

A second analysis, covering July 2025 through June 2026, will be added
once that data is available.

## Fire

An incident-level analysis of fire and EMS calls is planned as a
companion to the police analysis above, following the same methodology.

[Overview &rarr;](fire.qmd)
